lines: Oh, whoa-oh
No, oh-whoa-oh
No, oh-whoa-oh
No, oh-whoa-oh
Oh, oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh
We stood, swallowed by anger
A crescent moon on our backs, a home ravaged by storms
The bonfire was so beautiful I stared, mesmerized
Everyone will notice your darkness
We are night hawks
A storm drags across the sky of the temple hall
If you say so
If you simply wish, everything will come true
No, oh-whoa-oh
No, oh-whoa-oh
No, oh-whoa-oh
Oh, oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh
The tattered scraps we have left
We could only boast by flinging them wide open
A song of the rising, grinding cold wind
The depth of my eyes aches, sharp and clear
Mocked, laughed at, despised to the end
A beast that learned only how to pierce
The dawn we failed to die in greeted us
Light streams in from the depths of the crack
Even if we rot and scatter, even if we tear apart
Still, spring comes irresistibly
If you are dazzled and kneel
Then I will end it then
We are night hawks
A storm drags across the sky of the temple hall
If you say so
If you simply wish, everything will come true
